school: 法兰克国王（768-814）/罗马人的皇帝（800-814）/加洛林文艺复兴的赞助者/中世纪欧洲秩序的奠基者
historical_significance: 查理曼（742—814），加洛林王朝最伟大的君主，768年与弟卡洛曼共治法兰克，771年独掌大权。在位四十六年间发动五十余次战役，把法兰克王国从高卢-莱茵地区扩展为囊括今法、德、意北部与中欧的大帝国：774年应教皇之邀灭伦巴第王国并自兼伦巴第王；历时三十年（772-804）的萨克森战争以征服、强制基督教化（《萨克森敕令》以死刑维护教会什一税与洗礼）和定居立法相结合，将莱茵河以东蛮族永久纳入拉丁-基督教世界；778年起征讨伊比利亚的科尔多瓦埃米尔国（此役衍生《罗兰之歌》史诗），在比利牛斯南麓设西班牙马克；788年吞并巴伐利亚；791-796年击溃阿瓦尔汗国，夺取多瑙盆地巨量金银。800年圣诞节，教皇利奥三世在圣彼得大教堂为其加冕'罗马人的皇帝'，重建西部帝统（translatio imperii），确立此后近七百年神圣罗马帝国的观念母版。其内治构成'加洛林文艺复兴'：设宫廷学院（阿尔昆主持），推动加洛林小写体与正字法改革，令各修道院按统一范本誊抄古典与基督教文本（今日所存大部分拉丁古典文献皆赖此传世）；以年度敕令（capitularies）统一行政与教会纪律；派巡按使（missi dominici）巡回监察伯爵与主教；沿边境设马克（marches）与军事殖民地；改革币制确立银便士体系；806年颁布《王国分封令》（Divisio Regnorum）为三子预分帝国——虽因长子早逝最终由'虔诚者'路易独承，但分封继承自此成为加洛林政治的常设制度。814年死于亚琛行宫，葬于亚琛大教堂。843年《凡尔登条约》三分帝国，奠定法兰西、德意志、意大利三国的地理雏形。查理曼被称为'欧洲之父'（Pater Europae），是中世纪基督教-封建秩序与欧洲认同想象的共同源头。
historical_significance_en: Charlemagne (742-814), the greatest Carolingian monarch, shared the Frankish kingship with his brother Carloman from 768 and ruled alone after 771. Across a 46-year reign and more than fifty campaigns he expanded the Frankish kingdom into an empire spanning modern France, Germany, northern Italy, and Central Europe: in 774, summoned by the Pope, he destroyed the Lombard kingdom and took the Lombard crown; the thirty-year Saxon Wars (772-804) fused conquest, forced Christianization (the Capitulatio de partibus Saxoniae made tithes and baptism capital offenses), and settlement legislation, permanently binding the trans-Rhine peoples to the Latin-Christian world; his Iberian campaigns from 778 (the seed of the Song of Roland) created the Spanish March; Bavaria was absorbed in 788; the Avar Khaganate was crushed in 791-796, yielding vast Danubian treasure. On Christmas Day 800, Pope Leo III crowned him 'Emperor of the Romans' in St. Peter's, reviving western imperial rule (translatio imperii) and founding the conceptual template of the Holy Roman Empire for the next seven centuries. His domestic program was the Carolingian Renaissance: a palace school under Alcuin, the Carolingian minuscule and orthographic reform, and unified scriptoria that copied the classical and Christian corpus (most surviving Latin literature descends from these manuscripts); annual capitularies standardized administration and church discipline; missi dominici audited counts and bishops on circuit; marches and military colonies garrisoned the frontiers; a silver-penny monetary reform standardized coinage; and the Divisio Regnorum of 806 pre-partitioned the empire among his three sons—partition, though averted by his eldest son's death, became a standing institution of Carolingian politics. He died in 814 at Aachen and was buried in its cathedral. The Treaty of Verdun (843) split his empire, sketching the geography of France, Germany, and Italy. Proclaimed 'Father of Europe' (Pater Europae), Charlemagne stands at the origin of the medieval Christian-feudal order and of the European self-image.

cross_references.relation_type: 宽容帝国与同化帝国的镜像对照
cross_references.description_zh: 居鲁士以'保留被征服者原有叙事'换取合法性，查理曼以'抹除并替换被征服者原有叙事'（强制基督教化）求永久整合——两种帝国整合范式的极端对照，前者低成本但依赖精英合作，后者高成本但重塑人口结构。
cross_references.description_en: Cyrus bought legitimacy by preserving conquered narratives; Charlemagne sought permanent integration by erasing and replacing them (forced Christianization)—the extreme contrast between elite-cooptive and demographic-transformational imperial paradigms.
